rehearsal_name: SHS Private Beta Client Journey Rehearsal V1

notes: Today means supervised internal/private-beta rehearsal with manual operator controls.
External private beta still requires route smoke evidence, explicit beta constraints, and public/private leakage smoke.
Paid launch remains blocked by auth, persistence, launch evidence, report delivery controls, and build packet acceptance.

missing_runtime_support: Dedicated first-interest intake route was not confirmed
Structured lead source and qualification enforcement remain manual
Opportunity-to-production transition is not a hard runtime gate
Handoff packet approval evidence remains manual
Durable production persistence remains a paid-launch blocker
Signed or exportable build packet artifact
phases.private_public_boundary_status: SHS private operational until approved delivery
SHS private operational; no public impact publication
Client-facing launch is not SHF public impact
SHS private operational; blocked from direct SHF public surfaces
Client-facing report only unless Truth/Public Approval gates approve public impact use

missing_runtime_support: Automated upgrade conversion into proposal or project remains future work

blocker_log.blocker: Route smoke evidence is not captured in this rehearsal artifact.
blocker_log.impact: External beta could begin without proof that the full journey loads cleanly.
blocker_log.recommended_fix: Run and archive route smoke for lead, sales, ops, reports, ClientOps, and SHF-Next ops routes.

blocker_log.blocker: Explicit private beta operating constraints need owner signoff.
blocker_log.impact: Operators may treat beta data or unfinished flows as production-ready.
blocker_log.recommended_fix: Publish beta constraints: demo data only, manual persistence, no public approval, no paid launch claims.

blocker_log.blocker: No dedicated first-interest intake route was confirmed.
blocker_log.impact: Lead capture relies on manual sales/opportunity entry.
blocker_log.recommended_fix: Add or designate one lead intake surface after beta if sales flow proves insufficient.

blocker_log.blocker: Opportunity-to-production handoff is not a hard runtime transition.
blocker_log.impact: Handoff packet quality depends on operator discipline.
blocker_log.recommended_fix: Add handoff checklist enforcement or packet export after private beta learning.

blocker_log.blocker: Build Packet is not a signed/exportable development artifact.
blocker_log.impact: Development may start with incomplete acceptance criteria.
blocker_log.recommended_fix: Add exportable build packet with owner/client approval evidence.

blocker_log.blocker: No hard launch signoff gate was confirmed.
blocker_log.impact: Paid projects could launch without final approval/version evidence.
blocker_log.recommended_fix: Add final approval, version record, support tier activation, and ClientOps creation gate.

blocker_log.blocker: Production auth/session enforcement remains incomplete for paid use.
blocker_log.impact: Internal/client boundaries cannot be relied on for production paid customers.
blocker_log.recommended_fix: Implement production-grade authentication and route/session enforcement.

blocker_log.blocker: Durable persistence is not production-ready across the full lifecycle.
blocker_log.impact: Client records, handoffs, QA, reports, and support history can be lost or drift.
blocker_log.recommended_fix: Add durable persistence and backup/restore policy for paid operations.

blocker_log.blocker: Paid-client report approval and delivery ledger are not hard gates.
blocker_log.impact: Reports may be delivered without traceable approval or delivery status.
blocker_log.recommended_fix: Add report approval, save-as-PDF rule evidence, and delivery record.

blocker_log.blocker: Website Studio/WebMaker generation-to-delivery path remains incomplete for paid delivery.
blocker_log.impact: Website project delivery may rely on manual assembly.
blocker_log.recommended_fix: Define Website Studio generation, BuilderHub handoff, and delivery acceptance path.

blocker_log.blocker: Public/private leakage route scan should be captured before external beta.
blocker_log.impact: Demo/private operational data could accidentally appear on public surfaces.
blocker_log.recommended_fix: Run route leakage smoke for public SHF pages, admin SHS pages, and SHF-Next ops routes.

notes: Central Care Services must remain demo/private beta data.
No public SHF impact status is assigned.
Any future public impact publication must pass Truth Spine and public approval gates.

next_recommended_actions: Run route smoke evidence and archive results.
Publish private beta constraints before external beta.
Design paid launch gates for auth, persistence, launch signoff, report delivery, and build packet approval.
Keep Central Care Services private and never mark public-approved during rehearsal.
